self_spacing_policy.note: local geometric exemption of the assembled-path arclength neighbourhood; not a paper parameter and not an optical safety distance

immutability.rule: a published curve is frozen: neither a later net nor the next scene assembly may modify it

occupancy.publication_rule: published curves are the ACTUAL primitives of a VERIFIED net path: net_id + segment_id + occupancy_revision + full geometry; nodes, control points, chord polylines and AABBs are never the occupancy

no_optical_loss_model: geometry only: no dB, no insertion loss and no crosstalk number is produced

joint_validation_from_file.validator: native3d.validation.joint_validate (independent second implementation, standard library only)

verdict_semantics.pass: the net is declared accepted and this second implementation reproduces every acceptance check, including the occupancy identity
verdict_semantics.rejected_ok: the net is declared NOT accepted and this second implementation also finds a real geometric failure (or the net carries no path at all, which this validator cannot and does not re-derive)
verdict_semantics.no_path: the net carries no returned segment
verdict_semantics.fail: a contradiction between the declared status and the geometry
verdict_semantics.overall: fail only for a contradiction or a violation inside the PUBLISHED set; a rejected candidate is not part of the published-set invariant and is reported as evidence
